verdict.rationale: Pylon is a SaaS customer-support platform, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair openness question for that kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, an open-source license, or source-available code. The published OpenAPI spec and the official MCP server are an API contract and an integration, not product source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
